statement: The canonical home of this project is the repository N0-Gas-Labs/AI-Node-Gate. The prior organization No-Gas-Labs-Official (94 repositories) is historical reference only: its doctrine and capability are absorbed here as memory, its finance and blockchain material remains under security hold, and its Featherstone repositories remain archived. Nothing is bulk-recreated. The founding rule carries forward unchanged: autonomous nodes propose; a human decides at the gate; every decision is signed and recorded.
